rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Hong Kong term for petrol.

example.english: The car is out of petrol, so we need to refuel.
example.jyutping: gaa3 ce1 mou5 din6 jau4 laa3 jiu3 jap6 jau4

rows.note: Use this mainly in formal, technical, or written contexts rather than everyday conversation.

example.english: Petrol prices will be increased next month.
example.traditional: 汽油價格下月將會上調。
example.jyutping: hei3 jau4 gaa3 gaak3 haa6 jyut6 zoeng1 wui5 soeng5 tiu4
